result.question: Pull the latest oil sample for Transformer 1 at site MAIN and list which dissolved gases (hydrogen, methane, ethane, ethylene, acetylene, co) exceed the IEEE C57.104 Condition 1 single-gas limits. Also report the sample timestamp and how old the reading is. Only count combustible gases, and leave out co2, oxygen and nitrogen. | Gas | Value (ppm) | Condition 1 limit (ppm) | Exceeds? |

| Hydrogen (H2) | 2,850 | 100 | Yes |

Note: acetylene (7 ppm) came from the same 2024-01-19 sample as the other gases — no older-sample substitution was required.
